description: This file is a PHP source code defining a class `Activity` within the OpenCart admin dashboard extension namespace. It contains methods for rendering dashboard activity pages, saving settings, and retrieving activity data. The source code demonstrates typical MVC controller logic, including loading language files, models, handling form submissions, and rendering views.
